blight.hint: Step sideways out of the green cone
blight.name: Blighted breath

falseRefuge.hint: The solid ring is dangerous. Move inside or beyond it
falseRefuge.name: False refuge
falseRefuge.voice: Bera: “Stay in the shining ring. It is safe.”

hex.hint: Move away from the marked spot
hex.name: Arcane eruption

memoryCall.hint: Leave the solid marked circle; the voice is false
memoryCall.name: Borrowed command
memoryCall.voice: Rellan: “Hold your position. That is an order.”

pounce.hint: Step aside from the marked path
pounce.name: Pounce

ring.hint: Move close or beyond the outer ring
ring.name: Expanding ring

shot.hint: Move away from the marked spot
shot.name: Volley

stolenSelf.hint: Step diagonally off both solid lines; follow the real shadow
stolenSelf.name: Stolen self
stolenSelf.voice: Your own voice: “I remember this. Do exactly what I do.”
